prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize muscle gain and strength through proper nutrition timing around weightlifting sessions

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains at least 4 meals with high protein content (minimum 25g protein per meal) distributed throughout the day
Includes pre-workout and post-workout nutrition strategically timed around training session
Plan is presented in compact, easy-to-read format suitable for a single day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-focused athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein intake and meal timing around workout sessions with recovery nutrition

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain weight class (71 kg limit) while preparing for competition in 3 days, with adequate energy and strength

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals approximately 2,200-2,400 calories to maintain weight without excess
Includes high-protein foods (minimum 140g protein daily) to preserve muscle during weight management
Incorporates micronutrient-dense foods (leafy greens, lean meats, whole grains) to support performance
Specifies hydration strategy appropriate for weight class athlete
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport with strict weight management requirements (boxer or wrestler) balancing caloric needs with hydration and micronutrient density while staying within weight class

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with carbohydrate loading for high-intensity endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 4 meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack) totaling 3000-3500 calories appropriate for marathon training
Macronutrient ratio maintains 55-60% carbohydrates, 20-25% protein, 15-20% fat to support endurance performance
All meals are concise and practical to prepare within 1 day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-intensity endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high calorie intake and carbohydrate loading with specific macronutrient ratios
